description: Use this when you have a QR code’s id (from generate_qr_code or list_qr_codes) and need its status or finished image. While the code is still being painted it waits up to `wait` seconds (25 by default) for it to finish before answering, so call it again if it is still processing. Do not use it to make a new code.

wait.description: Seconds to wait for a processing code to finish before answering, 0 to 25.

name: get_qr_code

destination.description: Where a link code’s scans go; null for a Wi-Fi code.

error.description: Why the code failed, when it did.

id.description: The code’s id. A link code’s id is also the path of its short link: lowercase letters and digits, currently 6 characters. A Wi-Fi code’s id is a UUID. Treat every id as an opaque, case-sensitive string of up to 64 characters. It never changes.

imageUrl.description: The finished image (PNG), once the code has succeeded.

pageUrl.description: The code’s page in the app.

shortUrl.description: The link the code encodes (`https://qrx.to/<id>`); scans go through it to `destination`. Null for a Wi-Fi code.

status.description: `processing` until the picture is painted and checked to scan; then `succeeded` or `failed`. `queued` is reserved for a code waiting to start. More values may be added: treat anything other than `succeeded` or `failed` as still in progress.

style.description: The style id, if one was chosen.

type.description: `url` for a link code, `wifi` for a Wi-Fi code. More values may be added.

wifi.description: The network a Wi-Fi code joins; null for a link code. The password is never returned.

security.description: More values (such as `nopass`) may be added.

title: Get a QR code
